If every sample obeys \(q_k\le A\), the average of \(h(q_k)=q_k(A-q_k)(q_k-B)^2\) is \(-(41+3\sqrt{21})(m_3-84)/6\), while each summand is nonnegative, forcing equality; a strict peak below \(A\) would force every sample into \(\{0,B\}\), contradicting mean three. A fresh independent numerical evaluation of the displayed cubic-root witness produced one zero, three values \(A\), and three values \(B\). The frozen exact checker was also read and its group-algebra identities agree with the reconstruction.

final_claim: For \(P_{u,v}(k)=1+u\zeta^k+v\zeta^{3k}\) on \(\mathbb Z_7\), with \(|u|=|v|=1\), the exact minimum of the seven-sample squared peak is \((7+\sqrt{21})/2\). The phase pair \(u=e^{4\pi i/3}\), \(v=e^{2\pi i/3}\) attains it with squared-modulus multiset \(\{0,A,A,A,B,B,B\}\), where \(A=(7+\sqrt{21})/2\) and \(B=(7-\sqrt{21})/2\).
limitations: Only \(\{0,1,3\}\subset\mathbb Z_7\) with all three coefficient magnitudes equal to one is treated.
No complete minimizer-phase classification is claimed.
